summary.result: The results from hydrologic calibration for the catchment indicate a good prediction of the model with average ARE(Absolute Relative Error) of $24.6\%$ fur the runoff volume and $12\%$ for the peak flow.
summary.background: AnnAGNPS model was applied to a catchment mainly occupied with bushland for modeling non-point source pollution.
